methods.label: HL and complementary acute angles
methods.explanation: \(AB=DE\) (hypotenuses) and \(AC=DF\) (legs), so \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle DEF\) by HL. \(\angle E\) corresponds to \(\angle B\), and \(\angle B=90^\circ-35^\circ=55^\circ\). Therefore, \(\angle E=55^\circ\).
